service.name.description: Service name used in logs and process identification.

service.runtime_dir.description: Path to the directory used for runtime files (PID, sockets, etc.).

service.max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

service.worker_count.description: Number of worker threads/processes for handling requests.

service.host.description: Hostname or IP address to bind the service to. Use empty string or '0.0.0.0' to bind to all interfaces.

service.port.description: TCP port on which to listen for incoming connections.

service.ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for client connections.

service.ssl_cert_chain.description: Path to the SSL/TLS certificate chain file. Required if ssl_enabled is true.

service.ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL/TLS private key file. Required if ssl_enabled is true.

service.allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS headers. An empty list disables CORS.

service.log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging. Choices: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

service.log_file.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to log only to stdout/stderr.

service.verbose.description: Enable verbose debug logging (includes extra diagnostics, stack traces, etc.).

service.backend_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for backend service calls (e.g., to a media provider).

service.max_retries.description: Maximum number of automatic retry attempts for transient failures.

service.health_endpoint_enabled.description: Enable the health check endpoint (e.g., for container orchestrators).

service.health_endpoint_path.description: HTTP path for the health endpoint (e.g., /healthz, /health).
